sem_ligacao: No connection. Actions need a network — nothing was sent.
sem_ligacao_accao: No connection: get online to continue.
vazio_por_fazer: No deliveries assigned. When the store assigns you one, it shows up here.
entrega_nao_encontrada: Delivery not found. It may have been assigned to another courier.

detalhe.falhada_ajuda: Bring the goods back to the store. The store then returns them.

accoes.recolher: I picked it up at the store

entregar.referencia_ajuda: Required for M-Pesa and e-Mola: it is the code in the confirmation message.
entregar.diferenca_mais: You collected {{valor}} more than expected. It is recorded.
entregar.diferenca_menos: You collected {{valor}} less than expected. It is recorded.

falhar.aviso: The goods go back to the store. The customer is not charged.

mensagens.falhada: Recorded. Take the goods back to the store.
mensagens.erro_accao: Could not record it. Try again.
mensagens.cheguei: The customer was told you have arrived.
mensagens.erro_cheguei: Could not tell the customer you have arrived.

partilha.consentimento_texto: So the customer and the store can see where you are, this app will use your phone’s location.
partilha.consentimento_so_em_rota: Only while you have a delivery “on the way”. Otherwise nothing is read.
partilha.consentimento_quem_ve: Who sees it: the store and the customer of the delivery in progress. The customer only sees your first name.
partilha.consentimento_sem_historico: We only keep the last position, and delete it when the delivery ends. There is no route history.
partilha.sem_suporte: This phone or connection cannot use location. Open the app over HTTPS in a browser that supports location.
partilha.negada: Location is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings for this app — without it, the customer cannot see where you are.
partilha.a_partilhar: Sharing your location with the customer and the store
partilha.sem_canal: Trying to connect to share your location…
partilha.manter_aberta: Keep this app open and the screen on. With the phone locked or another app in front, your location stops being sent.

instalar.ios: On iPhone: tap Share (□↑) then «Add to Home Screen». Only then does it open full screen and keep you signed in.
instalar.android: Opens full screen, faster, and stays on your home screen.

online.ajuda: Go online to receive the deliveries that are close to you. We will ask for your location.
online.a_espera: You are online. When there is a delivery near you, an offer appears here — you have 30 seconds to accept it.

falha.sem_suporte: This phone or connection cannot use location. Open the app over HTTPS in a browser with location support.
falha.negada: Location is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings: without it we cannot choose who is closest to the store.
falha.indisponivel: Could not get your location. Check your GPS, move to an open area and try again.

oferta.aviso_cliente: The customer’s name, phone and address only appear after you accept.

partilha_online.consentimento_titulo: Share your position to receive deliveries
partilha_online.consentimento_texto: To offer you the deliveries closest to you, this app will use your phone’s location while you are online.
partilha_online.consentimento_so_em_rota: Only while you are online. When you go offline the position is deleted and no longer read.
partilha_online.consentimento_quem_ve: Who sees it: only the system, to choose who is closest to the store. The store and the customer only see your position during a delivery that is “on its way”.
partilha_online.consentimento_sem_historico: We only keep the last position. There is no trip history.
partilha_online.negada: Location is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings for this app — without it you will not receive offers.
partilha_online.a_partilhar: Online: the system knows where you are to offer you deliveries near you. The store and the customer do not see it.
partilha_online.sem_canal: Trying to connect to receive offers…

onboarding.subtitulo: To work as a courier we need to confirm who you are, your vehicle and your driving licence. Everything is required.

BI.ajuda: Photograph the front and the back. Put the document on a flat surface, with good light and no glare — the text must be readable.

CARTA_CONDUCAO.ajuda: Photograph the front and the back of the licence, with good light. It must be valid.

DOCUMENTO_VEICULO.ajuda: Photograph the registration book or the title. If the document has a back, photograph it too.

FOTO_VEICULO.ajuda: Photograph the vehicle you will use (for example, the motorbike) so that the number plate is visible.

FOTO_ROSTO.ajuda: A photo of your face, looking straight ahead, with good light and no sunglasses or cap.

ler.botao: Read the details from the photo
ler.sugestao: These details were read from the photo. Check each one and fix anything that is wrong — they are only saved when you confirm them.
ler.sem_resultado: This photo could not be read. Type the details by hand, or retake it with more light.
ler.indisponivel: Automatic reading is not available right now. Type the details by hand.

erros.formato_invalido: Invalid format. Check what is on the document.
erros.data_no_futuro: This date cannot be in the future.
erros.validade_antes_da_emissao: The expiry cannot be before the issue date.
erros.expirado: The document has expired. Only valid documents are accepted.

contacto.ajuda: Someone we can call if anything happens while you work.

concluir.pronto: Everything is done. Complete your registration to start receiving deliveries.

concluido.texto: You can now go online and receive deliveries.

aviso_antigo.texto: We now ask every courier for documents. You can keep working, but please complete your registration as soon as you can.

registo.na_frota_de: You are about to register as a courier for {{empresa}}.
registo.na_plataforma: Register to make deliveries for ControlCore stores near you.
registo.convite_invalido: This invitation is not valid or has been replaced. Ask the store for a new one.
registo.emergencia_ajuda: Someone we can call if anything happens while you work.
registo.consentimento_texto: To work as a courier we keep your details and the photos of your identity card, driving licence, vehicle and face. They are stored securely, with no end date, and only authorised people can see them — every access is logged. They are used to confirm who you are and to protect couriers and stores, and may be used for security checks in the future.
registo.consentimento_aceito: I have read and agree that my details and photos are kept and used for these purposes.

erros.telefone: Enter a valid Mozambican mobile number (for example 84 123 4567).
erros.senha_curta: The password must have at least 8 characters.
erros.senha_longa: The password can have at most 72 characters.

registo.erro_generico: Could not complete the registration. Try again.

sucesso.codigo_texto: This is your access code. You will use it, with your password, every time you sign in.
sucesso.guarde: Keep it. We also sent it by e-mail.
sucesso.email_nao_enviado: We could not send the e-mail with the code. Write it down now — it is what you use to sign in.
